statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. The Nasdaq's opening decline, a 10-year yield above 5%, hot PMI and hawkish Fed messaging lift Tail into the elevated band.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES; the active risk window reflects observed opening-auction continuation, while direct live NQ retracement detail remains incomplete.
headline: Elevated Tail as a rates-led opening decline extends after hot PMI.
body: The Nasdaq Composite was about 1% lower by 10:16 ET after opening only modestly down, while the 10-year Treasury yield moved above 5%. Flash Composite PMI reached 58.4 and Barr said further rate hikes will likely be needed. Direct live NQ pullback quality remains incomplete.
